name: print-social-german-school-feed-in-ornate-frames
title: Language-school feed displayed inside a pink baroque frame between two gold frames on dusty blue
whatItIs: A dusty blue crumpled-paper cover with a pink ribbon-bow title 'GERMAN PRO' in bold sans, and three ornate picture frames: pink baroque in the centre holding a 3x3 feed grid, and gold frames on either side holding single posts.
whatItMeans: Witty and gallery-like; framing posts as artworks lifts a feed to a museum.
techniques: Present designs in ornate picture frames.
Add a small bow and key as accents.
Centre the largest frame with the feed grid.

vocabulary.definition: A full profile grid inside one frame.
